description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (TasksAdapter) for displaying a list of tasks in an Android app, including view holder logic, item interaction handling, and diffing for efficient updates.

classes.name: TasksAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for task list, managing task item views and interactions.

classes.name: TasksAdapter.TaskViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual task items, binding task data to UI components.

methods.name: getItemOrNull
methods.description: Returns the task at the specified position or null if out of bounds.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TaskViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds task data to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a TaskEntity's data to the UI components within the ViewHolder.
